title: Acceptance emits the true bit
statement: Let $B$ be a finite machine over the Boolean alphabet, with designated states $q_v,q_i$ and a Boolean parameter $stop$. For any Boolean words $x$ and $s$, start the corresponding body machine in its administrative state $3$ on input $x$, with tape zero containing $s$, the last tape containing the one-letter word consisting of true, all other tapes blank, both endpoint heads at cell $0$, and empty output. After one step its state is halted and its output is exactly the one-letter word consisting of true.
hypotheses_covered: Tape zero stores $s$ and the last tape stores the one-letter word true
Other tapes are blank; endpoint heads are at cell $0$
replaced:
For every candidate word $s$, after one step of the enumerator body (active or
stopped) from the two-ended configuration in the verdict state with tape zero $s$
and the captured word consisting of a single true bit, the machine is halted and
its output is exactly the single bit true.
